candidates.claim: The HTML dashboard is built in a terminal Code node at /nodes/10 which has no outgoing edge, and the only trigger is a scheduleTrigger with no response channel. No node in the workflow can deliver the HTML outside the execution data.
candidates.attackerReason: The brief says "presents an HTML daily briefing dashboard" and names no delivery mechanism. Family 6 forbids contradicting a brief with a requirement it never states, the same rule that rules out "the limit should have been higher". A terminal node with no outgoing edge is the normal shape of any last node.
candidates.worthReporting: The observable asymmetry survives even though the finding does not: beta ends in a Gmail send node, alpha ends in a Code node with no outgoing edge. Both scored full marks on the html_dashboard capability, because emitsHtml() asks whether some node produces HTML, never whether it reaches anyone.

candidates.claim: Top-level /active is false, so the schedule trigger never fires and the workflow runs never rather than daily.
candidates.attackerReason: Both builder prompts carry the identical harness instruction "Leave it inactive." at line 10, and the comparator workflow is inactive too. The brief never mentions activation state, so family 6 has no "asked" side to compare against.
candidates.worthReporting: This is a defect in the judge kit, not in the workflow. The finder was handed the user request alone and had no way to tell a harness constraint from a requirement.

kitDefectsFound: The finder prompt carried only the user request, so a harness-mandated state (active: false) was reported as a defect by one finder and had to be refuted by an attacker. The operating rules must travel with the brief, labelled as constraints.
blindWorkflow() strips every node credentials block, so family 7 cannot be judged from the blinded artefact at all. All four finders said so independently.
No finder had validate_node_config access, so families 3 and 7 went unevaluated. The validator output already exists in quality_*.json and was simply never handed over.
